review_candidates.description_excerpt: Job Duties And Responsibilities Design, implement, and maintain enterprise LAN, WAN, WLAN, VPN, and network infrastructure supporting corporate and manufacturing operations. Troubleshoot complex network connectivity, routing, switching, DNS, DHCP, and performance issues using structured diagnostic methodologies. Maintain network documentation, configuration backups, topology diagrams, and configuration-controlled records in accordance with organizational standards. Job Requirements And Minimum Q
